units.leftText: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,
units.rightText: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s elect, and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

units.leftText: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;
units.rightText: in hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before times eternal;

units.leftText: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,
units.rightText: but in his own seasons manifested his word in the message, wherewith I was intrusted according to the commandment of God our Saviour;

units.leftText: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.
units.rightText: to Titus, my true child after a common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Saviour.

units.leftText: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—
units.rightText: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that were wanting, and appoint elders in every city, as I gave thee charge;

units.leftText: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.
units.rightText: if any man is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children that believe, who are not accused of riot or unruly.

units.leftText: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;
units.rightText: For the bishop must be blameless, as God’s steward; not self-willed, not soon angry, no brawler, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre;

units.leftText: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,
units.rightText: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober-minded, just, holy, self-controlled;

units.leftText: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.
units.rightText: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able both to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict the gainsayers.

units.leftText: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
units.rightText: For there are many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision,

units.leftText: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.
units.rightText: whose mouths must be stopped; men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre’s sake.

units.leftText: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”
units.rightText: One of themselves, a prophet of their own, said,

units.leftText: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
units.rightText: This testimony is true. For which cause reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

units.leftText: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
units.rightText: not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

units.leftText: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
units.rightText: To the pure all things are pure: but to them that are defiled and unbelieving nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

units.leftText: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
units.rightText: They profess that they know God; but by their works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.

units.leftText: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,
units.rightText: But speak thou the things which befit the sound doctrine:

units.leftText: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,
units.rightText: that aged men be temperate, grave, sober-minded, sound in faith, in love, in patience:

units.leftText: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,
units.rightText: that aged women likewise be reverent in demeanor, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good;

units.leftText: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,
units.rightText: that they may train the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,

units.leftText: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.
units.rightText: to be sober-minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed:

units.leftText: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.
units.rightText: the younger men likewise exhort to be sober-minded:

units.leftText: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,
units.rightText: in all things showing thyself an ensample of good works; in thy doctrine showing uncorruptness, gravity,

units.leftText: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.
units.rightText: sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of us.

units.leftText: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,
units.rightText: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters, and to be well-pleasing to them in all things; not gainsaying;

units.leftText: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
units.rightText: not purloining, but showing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

units.leftText: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
units.rightText: For the grace of God hath appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

units.leftText: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;
units.rightText: instructing us, to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly and righteously and godly in this present world;

units.leftText: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,
units.rightText: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

units.leftText: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.
units.rightText: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a people for his own possession, zealous of good works.

units.leftText: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
units.rightText: These things speak and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no man despise thee.

units.leftText: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
units.rightText: Put them in mind to be in subjection to rulers, to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready unto every good work,

units.leftText: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
units.rightText: to speak evil of no man, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all meekness toward all men.

units.leftText: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
units.rightText: For we also once were foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, hating one another.

units.leftText: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
units.rightText: But when the kindness of God our Saviour, and his love toward man, appeared,

units.leftText: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,
units.rightText: not by works done in righteousness, which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy he saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing of the Holy Spirit,

units.leftText: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;
units.rightText: which he poured out upon us richly, through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

units.leftText: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
units.rightText: that, being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

units.leftText: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;
units.rightText: Faithful is the saying, and concerning these things I desire that thou affirm confidently, to the end that they who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men:

units.leftText: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
units.rightText: but shun foolish questionings, and genealogies, and strifes, and fightings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

units.leftText: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,
units.rightText: A factious man after a first and second admonition refuse;

units.leftText: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.
units.rightText: knowing that such a one is perverted, and sinneth, being self-condemned.

units.leftText: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.
units.rightText: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, give diligence to come unto me to Nicopolis: for there I have determined to winter.

units.leftText: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.
units.rightText: Set forward Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.

units.leftText: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.
units.rightText: And let our people also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

units.leftText: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith.
units.rightText: All that are with me salute thee. Salute them that love us in faith.
